idx_f5e4efeb-4a01-469b-b491-ddc16ac1b07b.text: Mohsen was very kind and I felt completely safe riding around Rome with him in his Vespa. He was very knowledgeable with information about the tourist attractions we stopped at and even took great photos.

idx_069251e2-2ce4-4d6a-9d2f-4f35ea9841e4.text: Awesome experience. Seyed took me to places I never thought would have go and took all my pictures without any trouble! Will recommend him a thousand time. I got in love with Rome!

idx_df763c57-90cb-413d-ad1b-b66f993cef4c.text:
This experience was amazing value with a three hour ride and a some food and drink along the way.

I didn’t ask for any specific locations (other than not needing to see the colosseum again) so it was great to just go around on a Vespa. It also meant I could see a lot all over the city, which would normally have taken ages by public transport and you can pick where to go back by yourself if you want to go inside places or see more.

Lots of photos were offered - even one on the Vespa that made it look like I knew how to ride ;)

I’m a solo traveller so this was a great option for me!

Our host (not actually Brent) on the day was great! He seemed really passionate about the subject and was good at engaging the group with stories and insights about the colosseum.

The time in the underground isn’t much (just 20 minutes - that’s all each group is allowed), and you don’t really walk through much as it’s taken up by archeologists (which is amazing), but it was still great to be there and see some of it up close.

We had amazing weather and the group was very friendly, which I’ve found happens a lot with Airbnb experiences :)

What a lovely night!
We had a good group who all connected and enjoyed eating together.

Jordana had great stories about a number of dishes and drinks to share that made it feel very personal.

There was also a variety of dishes and drinks. Plus, we were given tips on places to go for pinchos if we wanted to do our own night another time. It was a lovely experience and I’d recommend it to all :)

I really love that this experience exists. I love film and it was a pleasure to be able to see a French film while in France that I could understand (with the subtitles).

Popcorn and a drink were included which is nice, I would have loved a wine option instead of cider though. Everyone working there was very lovely.

The venue itself is also lovely and feels a bit special. You could come early for a drink at the nice bar I think too. A very cute cinema and close to public transport.

Unfortunately though I arrived and it wasn’t clear where to go. I did see Manon in the end though who directed me where to go and pointed out some people who had joined a different tour earlier. Most people were already seated when I arrived so not many people to chat to, which was fine but didn’t meet expectations. I’m not really sure how the other people had come to event, as I don’t feel they were part of the Airbnb group (also fine).

I’d go to a frenchlation event again, but just go on to it with different expectations :)

Silvia made to feel comfortable from the start. Kicking off with a cute bakery, the tour included small places you may not have known to try if it weren’t for this tour.

Even though it was raining, she had a spot to stop out of the rain in each place and try the food.

A very lovely and thoughtful tour. The group seemed engaged with stories or anecdotes in every place we went and it seemed like Silvia knew most of the shop owners quite well. I would recommend this tour :)

idx_05b5db3f-8f7c-4bfc-9766-548ba138bf17.text: Seyed not only was a safe and great Vespa guide, but he was also welcoming and extremely kind! He was patient when I wanted to stop and take pictures. He also happily took pictures of me, which was appreciated since I was a solo traveler! Seyed also took me to some great local places off the tourist circuit, which was really appreciated. It was a great tour, and because he had some free time, he spent some extra time with me free of charge. I TOTALLY recommend the night tour. Rest up before and do it! It was great to see Rome by night, and the touristy sites weren't very crowded. Follow his advice and wear a jacket!! It gets cool at night. Thanks, Seyed!!! It was really wonderful.
